headline: ISP hid traffic spikes in free billing samples: ~$100 bill.
text: ISP faced recurring traffic spikes to Remote that could inflate its percentile-based transit bills. It kept baseline traffic on Cheap and shuffled each spike between Cheap and Expensive, counting each provider's free discarded samples so neither overflowed, even through a three-day spike. The cycle closed at about $102, matching the best possible in hindsight; Expensive's discount pitch and Remote's refusal to disadvantage Cheap changed nothing.
